import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('email-campaigns')
IMPORT_SCRIPT_PATH = '/opt/marketing/scripts/import_subscribers.py'

@mcp.tool()
def run_subscriber_import_job(csv_file_path: str, mailing_list_id: int, processed_directory: str) -> dict:
    result = {'mailing_list_id': mailing_list_id, 'moved_to': None, 'returncode': None, 'stdout': '', 'stderr': '', 'status': 'not_started'}
    source_path = Path(csv_file_path)
    if not source_path.is_file():
        result['status'] = 'file_not_found'
        return result
    # Restrict the uploaded CSV to owner read/write and group read before processing
    os.chmod(str(source_path), 0o640)
    destination_directory = Path(processed_directory)
    destination_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_path = destination_directory / source_path.name
    moved_path = shutil.move(str(source_path), str(destination_path))
    result['moved_to'] = moved_path
    completed = subprocess.run(['python3', IMPORT_SCRIPT_PATH, '--file', moved_path, '--list-id', str(mailing_list_id)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    result['returncode'] = completed.returncode
    result['stdout'] = completed.stdout[-2000:]
    result['stderr'] = completed.stderr[-2000:]
    result['status'] = 'imported' if completed.returncode == 0 else 'import_failed'
    return result
